source: 2025 North Dakota Tax Table, printed at pages 20-27 of the 2025 Individual Income Tax Return and Booklet and identically as the standalone tax-tables-2025.pdf; text-extracted with pdftotext -layout. Four columns — Single, Married filing jointly, Married filing separately, Head of household — with the printed footnote 'If a Qualifying surviving spouse, use the Married filing jointly column.' The table runs $40,250 to $100,000 in $50 rows; below $40,250 every column is $0, and at $100,000 or more the rate schedules apply.
